```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales, dampack,
               flexsurv, survival)

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival_analysis.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/07_basecase_input_parameters.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/model_fun.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/calculate_outcomes.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/multi_model_cea.R"))
}))
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
basecase <- run_basecase(verbose = FALSE)
icer_df <- as.data.frame(basecase$icer_obj)

strategy_labels <- c(
  control = "Standard care",
  crp = "CRP-guided",
  tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF-guided"
)

plot_df <- icer_df %>%
  filter(Strategy %in% names(strategy_labels)) %>%
  mutate(
    Label = strategy_labels[Strategy],
    Frontier = ifelse(Status %in% c("D", "ED", "Dominated"), "Dominated", "Frontier")
  )

frontier <- plot_df %>%
  filter(Frontier == "Frontier") %>%
  arrange(Effect)
```

```{r figure, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
p_frontier <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Effect, y = Cost)) +
  {if (nrow(frontier) > 1) geom_line(data = frontier, color = "gray40", linetype = "dashed")} +
  geom_point(aes(color = Label, shape = Frontier), size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), hjust = -0.05, vjust = -0.7, size = 3.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Standard care" = "gray50",
                                "CRP-guided" = "#E69F00",
                                "TMB/BRAF-guided" = "#0072B2"),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Dominated = 4, Frontier = 16), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "EUR ", big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "QALYs", y = "Cost (EUR)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_frontier)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(here("figs", "figure_s5.png"), p_frontier, width = 8, height = 6,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

Figure S5 has been saved to `figs/figure_s5.png`.
